steps.name: 验证验收标准
steps.description: 验证 spec 中声明的验收标准：AC-1: `docpath worktree create feature-a` no longer prints a generic `DOCPATH_SESSION=codex-feature-a` recommendation; generic output uses agent-neutral guidance.；AC-2: Worktree docs/skill describe DocPath worktrees as agent-neutral and show Codex/Claude/OpenCode as adapter examples.；AC-3: `docpath worktree create feature-a --backlog R-268` records or copies enough target context that the new worktree can act on R-268 without `next --agent` defaulting to an unrelated backlog item.；AC-4: `docpath worktree doctor` output includes clearer branch uniqueness/merge readiness metadata while preserving existing fields.；AC-5: Tests cover default create guidance, `--backlog` behavior, doctor metadata, and the preserved Codex adapter boundary.；AC-6: `docpath check`, `docpath review`, and targeted tests pass before closeout, with any remaining follow-up backlog documented.
steps.acceptance: AC-1: `docpath worktree create feature-a` no longer prints a generic `DOCPATH_SESSION=codex-feature-a` recommendation; generic output uses agent-neutral guidance.；AC-2: Worktree docs/skill describe DocPath worktrees as agent-neutral and show Codex/Claude/OpenCode as adapter examples.；AC-3: `docpath worktree create feature-a --backlog R-268` records or copies enough target context that the new worktree can act on R-268 without `next --agent` defaulting to an unrelated backlog item.；AC-4: `docpath worktree doctor` output includes clearer branch uniqueness/merge readiness metadata while preserving existing fields.；AC-5: Tests cover default create guidance, `--backlog` behavior, doctor metadata, and the preserved Codex adapter boundary.；AC-6: `docpath check`, `docpath review`, and targeted tests pass before closeout, with any remaining follow-up backlog documented.
